persona: film-loving, design-literate visitor who hates gimmicks

screens.why: Cold open earns it: play card, broomstick over Hogwarts, dive to a glowing sea, blackletter name lands. The last 6 s are a still hero that waits for me.
Gold iris opens on the Black Pearl, scroll-driven; it reads like a film cut, not a widget. Ship holds for the heading stop.
Short 'research journal in four acts' chapter list; promises a structure and hints there is something to play. Small type, lots of dark.
First text wall: four columns of small serif on dark for 8 s. After the cold open it feels like a CV, not a film.
Text wall slides away into a pinned harbour-at-night plate with a route map; the picture gives me a reason to keep going.
Beat 2: harbour dissolves to a storm swell as the copy changes; the pinned plate does the work and the text stays short.
Storm clears to a moonlit teal sea; each beat changes the picture, so scrolling feels like cause and effect.
Sunrise sea, then the Kraken's Storm swells up as the hand-off into Act II. Top two thirds of the frame is empty dark for a beat.
Wave wipes into the 3 Idiots lecture hall, drone sketch on the chalkboard, 'The Workshop' title card. Best image on the page.
Camera pans down the hall to the pen case while a drone glyph glides through the dark; sparse but purposeful.
'Led by what survived scrutiny.' sits still for 8 s: small body copy, empty right half. Momentum drops here.
Chalkboard with a bar chart and a beam of light; a visual after text. The gauntlet checklist is small but supports it.
Heading plus two tiny paragraphs beside a dim corridor photo, 6 s static. First of a repeated text-left, photo-right template.
Blue blueprint diagram arrives; the colour change and the chalk-circled stats wake the section up.
'What is a machine?' chalkboard still with the drone glyph and a one-line quote: a film-still moment, short.
Pipeline blueprint, then a dense bullet block. Same template again: seen it.
The tall drone photo is good, but the left column is dense mono bullets and tiny stats, unreadable at scroll speed.
'See the thesis, not just read it.' Short headline, the chart line draws itself; legible and has a payoff.
Equity curve climbs, then the homemade-drone photo rises into frame; movement and a photo reset my attention.
Big photo, then a flat skills list; 6 s of mostly static type. The 'Take off' pill is tiny and easy to miss.
Skills list plus a postage-stamp blueprint at bottom right; most of the screen is dead dark.
'The kill-list' with the pen photo and a Dead Eye tag: an unusual idea (what I killed), readable headline.
Spreadsheet-like project list in tiny rows with a mystery chip glyph; reads as a table, not a scene.
List keeps going, then a dark gap before 'Three films and a game' appears at the bottom. The longest slog on the page ends here.
'Three films and a game' index with four chips: a clean breather and a promise of fast plates.
Black Pearl by moonlight returns with a compass ring and 'Not all treasure is silver and gold, mate.' A callback to the opening.
Yellow scooter at Pangong Lake with a ring and 'Aal izz well.' A pretty still that changes the mood.
Red Dead Redemption 2 plate in dead-eye red, 'Be loyal to what matters.' Strong colour jump.
Hogwarts Express over the viaduct, 'It does not do to dwell on dreams.' Fourth plate in a row, but each is graded differently so it holds.
Dark hand-off into a sunrise sliver; the sun glint is a nice cinematic cut. Upper half is empty dark for a second.
Fog lifts off the Frontier plate into golden hour; second-best image on the page.
'Discipline, service, and a trained eye.' Big headline over the heartland photo, one idea.
Tiny mono columns for 'three arenas' beside a small parchment map; one clip, but all fine print.
Pinned horse-at-dusk silhouette while short text blocks scroll past; the photo carries it.
'What's in the satchel': a line-drawn bag with four icons begins to rise; looks touchable.
WANTED poster for Aryan Sharma on a stone wall: a human, slightly funny payoff with a reply-by-email line.
Curved page edge wipes dark to cream journal; a real change of medium. Brightness jump, 6 s stop.
Journal entries with a pencil sketch per entry (grid, scales, ladder) and a tiny running horse; charming, low contrast.
More entry titles on empty cream with 'soon' energy; nothing to read yet.
Pine silhouette dissolves cream to night; 'In their words.' campfire with testimonials. Quotes are small and it dwells 8 s.
The Campfire plate slides in and the camera moves toward the Great Hall; a good scene hand-off.
Great Hall, floating candles, 'The Light' title card; the most cinematic frame after the sea.
Great Hall sinks and a parchment rises, 'The Map of the Principles'; fresh surface, clear change of scene.
Marauder's Map parchment with footprints and 'A small philosophy of work.' Beautiful, though it dwells for 8 s.
Principle cards (Act then release, Weigh the consequences...) repeat one layout; seen it by the second.
Parchment closes on 'Attend carefully', night sky returns with the contact headline and floating candle.
'Let's talk research, markets...' with a floating candle and an email pill: a clear ask, readable.
Closing credits and 'Mischief managed.' land as a film-style payoff; the credits text is tiny and dim.
Page ends in black on the last quote; nothing pulls me further (a natural stop, not a flaw).
Cold open: play card, broomstick, glowing sea, name; the hero then holds still for 6-8 s.
Gold iris opens on the Black Pearl; a ghosted 'The Crossing' title flashes over the ship.
Contents list 'A research journal in four acts' arrives as the ship exits; short.
'A builder of quantitative systems.' arrives in gold, then settles into a two-column paragraph wall for 8 s.
Four small principle blocks under the wall; still reading, no picture.
Harbour-at-night plate pinned beside 'How the methodology was earned.'; the route map joins.
'Trading alongside my father' and a storm swell; the plate answers the copy.
Pine Script, 'They failed out-of-sample', and the sea shifts from storm to teal inside 4 s; brisk and legible.
Sunrise over the sea, 'A validation methodology of my own', then the Kraken's Storm rises.
Wave wipe into the 3 Idiots chalkboard with the drone sketch; strong.
'The Workshop' title card, then a pan to the pen case with a drone glyph.
'Led by what survived scrutiny.' sits still for 8 s, text only; a half-faded typing reveal at the start looks glitchy.
Chalkboard with a light beam and bar chart behind 'seven-part validation gauntlet'; a visual.
Pre-registration copy and Quantitative Trading Research over a corridor photo; text-left, photo-right template.
Blue blueprint diagram and stat tiles; the colour change helps.
Narrow stack of stats and a chalk-circled sentence; fine detail, no motion.
'What is a machine?' chalkboard still; short and filmic.
Pipeline blueprint, then dense text beside a bench photo; the template repeats.
Tall drone photo with dense mono bullets and a stat column; unreadable at speed.
Same screen continues: stats and mono text, no change for 4 s.
'See the thesis, not just read it.' The chart line draws in; clean and short.
Homemade-drone photo rises; a 'Take off' pill is visible on the image.
'What I can actually do.' skills list static for 6 s; the blueprint thumbnail is cramped at right.
Skills list gives way to 'The kill-list' heading with the pen photo; the idea hooks.
Project list rows in small text, little change.
More list rows; one clip of the same.
List tail, then 'Three films and a game' fades up out of empty dark.
'Three films and a game' index with four chips and a short hint line about the egg count.
Black Pearl plate with the 'silver and gold, mate' quote.
3 Idiots scooter plate, 'Aal izz well.'
Red Dead plate, 'Be loyal to what matters.'
Hogwarts Express plate.
Red Dead Redemption 2 hand-off with a sunrise sliver.
Sunrise plate holds for 6 s but is beautiful; golden-hour caption.
'Discipline, service, and a trained eye.' over the heartland photo.
'Discipline in three arenas': fine-print columns with the parchment map below; low payoff.
Pinned horse silhouette with 'Showing up unprompted'.
Two more mono text blocks beside the same pinned horse; same photo, same layout.
'What's in the satchel': line-drawn bag and icons; the WANTED poster rises.
WANTED poster for Aryan Sharma, then the page curves to cream.
Cream journal 'Thinking in public, soon.' after a hard flip from dark; 6 s stop.
Entries with sketches; a tiny horse runs along the bottom of the page.
'Mandarin and global markets', then a pine-forest silhouette closes the journal; clean transition.
'In their words.' campfire plate, 6 s with testimonials.
Quotes finish and 'The Campfire' plate slides in.
Campfire dissolves to the Great Hall; 'The Light' with a thin progress bar.
Great Hall held for the heading stop, then the parchment rises.
Marauder's Map lands: 'A small philosophy of work.' 8 s, but gorgeous.
Principle cards repeat (Act then release, Weigh the consequences).
'Synthesize the constraints', 'Attend carefully': the fifth card of one layout.
Map closes into the night sky and the contact headline.
Contact ask with floating candle and email pill, then the credits begin.
Credits, 'To be continued', and the 'Mischief managed.' payoff.
End of page: black; nothing more pulls me (a natural stop).

discovery.note: Same.

discovery.thing: 'Skip to the research' and 'Skip intro' pills (top right)
discovery.note: Utility rather than play, but a kind escape hatch; I would use it on a second visit.

discovery.note: A visible 0/12 is a real game hook, but at this size I cannot tell what an egg is until the contents hint explains it.

discovery.thing: Teal viewfinder bracket around the ship on the horizon (hero)

discovery.thing: Compass emblem under the hero and 'Jack's compass: it points to what you want most' label

discovery.thing: Hint line under 'A research journal in four acts' (egg hunt, two buried games, Take off, Dead Eye)
